obS1Title.message: Skip the law degree to read a dense lease

obS1Lede.message: Terms of service, medical letters, rental contracts, research abstracts. The words that matter sit under a pile of jargon, and you read the same paragraph five times to be sure. Plainly turns it into plain English at a reading level you choose.

obS1Pt.message: Made for the moments dense text becomes a real barrier. Dyslexia, ADHD, reading in a second language, or a tired brain at the end of a long day.

obS1Cap.message: A page you actually got sent
obS1Cap.description: Caption above the dense-document mock on step 1.

obS2Title.message: Get the hard paragraph plain in about a second

obS2Lede.message: Highlight a confusing sentence, click the Plainly icon, and the side panel gives it back at your level. Facts, names, numbers, and dates stay exactly as written. Nothing gets added and nothing gets invented.

obS3Title.message: Save the reading level that fits how you read

obS3Lede.message: Simple lands around a grade five reading level with common words. Want it gentler or a touch higher? ELI5 goes to about grade three and Plain sits near grade eight. Choose your default here and every read starts there.

obS3Pt.message: It runs on Chrome built-in AI, right on your computer. The text you read never goes to a server, so you can simplify a private letter with the wifi off.

obS4Lede.message: Your reading stays on your machine. The read path makes no server call at all, no account, no sync, nothing sent anywhere.

obS4Pt.message: A plain-English reader is where you meet the studio. The larger goal is an honest layer for the whole extension world, one tool at a time, with no tracking and no spam.

obTrust1Text.message: Your selections and results live in local browser storage. No account, no sync server, nothing sent anywhere.

obS6Title.message: Get any dense page readable in three moves

obS6Lede.message: Pin Plainly, highlight the hard part on any page, and click the icon. The side panel does the rest. Here is the short version worth remembering.

obSignTitle.message: Get a note from the developer

obSignText.message: I build every extension on my own, in the open. If something reads wrong or breaks, write to me and I answer. Extensions are only the start. The plan is an honest layer for the whole browser, and going Pro helps ship the next piece of it.

obS6More.message: Want more from the studio? The same Pro plan supports the rest of the toolkit as it ships.
